diagrams.title: Expense Data Model
diagrams.description: Entity Relationship Diagram for the Expense Tracker local storage schema.

diagrams.title: Add Expense Workflow
diagrams.description: Detailed logic flow for adding a new expense including validations and edge case handling.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    START[Start: Add Expense]
    INPUT[User enters amount, date, category, description]
    VAL_AMT{ "Amount > 0?" }
    VAL_DATE{ "Date in future?" }
    WARN[Display Future Date Warning]
    SAVE[Save to localStorage]
    UPDATE[Update Dashboard Totals]
    END[End: Expense Added]

    START --> INPUT
    INPUT --> VAL_AMT
    VAL_AMT -- "No" --> INPUT
    VAL_AMT -- "Yes" --> VAL_DATE
    VAL_DATE -- "Yes" --> WARN
    VAL_DATE -- "No" --> SAVE
    WARN --> SAVE
    SAVE --> UPDATE
    UPDATE --> END

diagrams.title: Expense Management Sequence
diagrams.description: Interaction between the User, UI, and LocalStorage for core operations.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant UI as "UI Dashboard"
    participant Storage as "localStorage"

    User ->> UI: Input Expense Details
    UI ->> UI: Validate Amount & Date
    UI ->> Storage: Save Expense Object
    Storage -->> UI: Confirm Save
    UI ->> UI: Recalculate Totals
    UI -->> User: Display Updated List & Totals

    User ->> UI: Click Delete Expense
    UI ->> User: Request Confirmation
    User -->> UI: Confirm Delete
    UI ->> Storage: Remove Expense by ID
    Storage -->> UI: Confirm Removal
    UI ->> UI: Recalculate Totals
    UI -->> User: Refresh Dashboard View
